name: agentbridge
description: Drive a local AgentBridge runtime from any MCP client: agents, office tools, documents and web research.
long_description: AgentBridge is a self-hosted AI agent for office work (documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDF reports, e-mail, web research). It already exposes MCP over HTTP at http://localhost:5290/mcp; this bundle is the stdio bridge that lets stdio-only MCP hosts use the same runtime. Start AgentBridge first, then add the extension: the `agent_run` tool executes one autonomous run for a prompt.

endpoint.title: AgentBridge endpoint
endpoint.description: HTTP MCP endpoint of the running AgentBridge instance (default: http://localhost:5290/mcp).
